limitations: UAC consent transitions were not exercised.
Playwright drives the application page alongside its visible native Edge window; physical desktop interaction was not performed.
Offline, HTTP failure, rate limiting, ETag and malicious-file cases use deterministic native Go tests.
Legacy Windows Server versions and every server-role collector were not exercised.

notes: Makes HTML inventory tables compact by default, with horizontal scrolling instead of forced wrapping. Optional wrapping remains available for longer values.

Adds copy controls for tables, raw text, sections and the full report; individual values remain directly selectable. Copied text preserves complete reported values. A selectable manual-copy panel remains available when browser clipboard permissions prevent automatic copying.
Adds table filtering and sorting without discarding captured rows. Copying a dataset retains every reported row, including rows hidden by its filter.

checks.name: Long paths remain full, selectable and compact with horizontal scrolling
Wrap toggle expands values deliberately and returns to compact rows
Table filters retain all data for copy, disclose counts and print every row
Header sorting is numeric, keyboard accessible and resets original order on third click
Copy table preserves every command, array, multiline, empty, error and Unicode cell as quoted TSV
Section/full-report copying includes collapsed datasets, final rows and notices without controls
Raw multiline copy retains whitespace, tabs, quotes and final Unicode line
Clipboard rejection uses legacy copy and confirms only after success
Both automatic paths blocked leave full selected manual text and support keyboard copy/close
Saved offline HTML with no Clipboard API exposes complete manual-copy fallback
Manual copy remains keyboard usable and Close is reachable in a 390 by 300 viewport
Production application iframe retains copy controls and fallback under unchanged CSP
No script errors or external report requests

limitations: Synthetic browser/clipboard tests do not reproduce user enterprise clipboard policies or physical desktop interaction.
Synthetic data only; no live customer inventory, AD/DHCP diagnosis, Office visual validation, human UAC/physical desktop interaction or legacy Windows field validation.
Benchmark uses Linux PowerShell 7.4.13 synthetic data and excludes collection, ZIP and network time; not a user-host timing guarantee.
Existing lossy CSV/HTML cannot recover original array values; fresh collection required.
SHA256 verifies byte integrity, not publisher signing; release assets must never be replaced.
